verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own cardholder credential flows: an iOS SDK lets cardholders change their PIN in-app, and Adyen-issued cards can be enrolled in 3D Secure via one-time password or out-of-band authentication. The evidence does not show a server-side API for setting the initial PIN or resetting a forgotten one, and does not explicitly show 3DS enrollment is fully API-driven rather than configured through Adyen. Missing for 10: documented PIN set-at-issuance and PIN reset API flows, explicit API endpoints for 3DS enrollment, region-specific 3DS handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, cardholder credentials are manageable through the API — PIN set and reset flows, 3DS enrollment for online use where the region requires it — without support tickets

citations.quote: Allow your cardholders change their personal identification number (PIN) within your app.
